playerCharacter.name: The Survivor

stats.agility: battle-tested (barely dodged blade slash as floor tilted ninety degrees)
stats.intelligence: tested (received fleeting vision of boy before obsidian tower)
stats.strength: tested (endured blade clash, gripped Awakened Fruit under extreme duress)
stats.willpower: resonating (Awakened Fruit burning white-hot, synced with extracted memory)
stats.memoryIntegrity: unstable (saw fleeting vision of past, identity still fractured)

enemies: The Mirror Self (now wielding stolen recollection)
goals: Recover lost memories (partially seen—boy before obsidian tower)
Claim the truth from the Mirror Self
obstacles: Mirror Self confrontation (ongoing, now with stolen memories)
Divided Forgotten Souls (FIGHT BACK vs LET IT CONSUME)
Psychological whispers from divided Forgotten Souls

npcs.name: Forgotten Soul
npcs.description: Whispers from the void, now divided—some shriek FIGHT BACK! while others murmur Let it consume you. They erupt from cracking walls, their voices warping through the collapsing corridor.

npcs.name: The Mirror Self
npcs.description: A sentient doppelganger wielding a blade, wearing The Survivor's face. Catches stolen memories midair, its face twisting into something almost compassionate. Eyes now flickering with stolen recollection. Snarls: 'You want the truth? Prove you can survive it.' Dwells within the Hidden Bunker.

Tower of Hell grid.description: A server with a hidden secret, shrouded in thunderous dread and a bruised sky. Walls now crack open like wounds, revealing flickering memories trapped beneath—childhood laughter, a door slamming shut, a voice screaming DON'T FORGET.
notableFeatures: Shifting laser beams carving the air like razors
Warping corridor with breathing walls and tilting floors
Walls cracking open to reveal flickering memories

Hidden Bunker.description: A guarded area with a mystery to crack, now breached and warping. Inside: a mirror holding a sinister reflection. The corridor is COLLAPSING inward, reality fracturing around the combatants. Steel meets will across shifting, tilting tile.
notableFeatures: Floors that tilt ninety degrees during confrontation

Awakened Fruit.description: A powerful fruit with unknown abilities, now burning white-hot against The Survivor's chest. Resonates with extracted memory, pulsing like a second heartbeat. Erupted with heat during the mirror confrontation.

Blade (Mirror Self).description: A blade wielded by the Mirror Self, its edge catching pale light. Used to slash at The Survivor and extract memories. Raised again after the fleeting vision.

Lost Memory.description: A memory that fell from The Survivor during the blade clash—caught midair by the Mirror Self, who claims to know everything The Survivor has forgotten. The Mirror Self's face twists into something almost compassionate while holding it.

Memory Fragment.description: A fleeting vision that blazed through The Survivor's mind for one blinding second—a boy standing before an obsidian tower, clutching something glowing. Then it vanished.
